issue.body:
**Kibana version:** 7.8.0 BC5

**Describe the bug:** Kibana seems to generate a lot of logs in ES every 10 minutes.  No change has been done really to the settings, it's all default.

**Provide logs and/or server output (if relevant):**
```
[2020-06-03T16:42:05,510][INFO ][o.e.c.r.a.AllocationService] [RATONBOX-DESKTO] updating number_of_replicas to [0] for indices [.kibana-event-log-7.8.0-000002]
```

**Any additional context:**
Looks very much related to this one: https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/63365
Labeling with the same team.

body: I don't think this is ILM-related, the `AllocationService` is reacting to the `auto_expand_replicas: '0-1'` setting in the Kibana template. This indicates something with the allocation code, not ILM.

This is caused by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/53965 I think, which now  precomputes the new cluster state before simulating the rollover (which is triggered every 10 minutes by ILM). The logging which is referred to here happens while that cluster state is being computed. I'm not sure why we need to call `AllocationService.reroute` on that temporarily created cluster state, but that triggers this logging.

@henningandersen can you have a look? Two options here: 1) Move the logging elsewhere 2) Not use AllocationService for these kind of simulation steps.
